mappings.note: Translation v1 contains the superscription (title) 'For the choir director... A Psalm of David' which is not present in OSMAIN's verse text. OSMAIN includes this title as part of its Verse 1, but WLC separates it into a distinct Verse 1.
Translation v2 corresponds to the second half of OSMAIN v1 ('Only in God is my soul silent...'). The first part (the title) was handled in WLC v1.
Content matches OSMAIN v2 ('Only he is my rock and salvation...').
Content matches OSMAIN v3 ('How long will you attack a man?'). Note: WLC splits the 'wall' metaphor differently than some English versions, but it aligns with OSMAIN's single verse structure here.
Content matches OSMAIN v4 ('Only to overthrow him...'). The 'Selah' is included in both at the end of this verse.
Content matches OSMAIN v5 ('Be still before God...').
Content matches OSMAIN v6 ('Only he is my rock and salvation...'). Note: WLC omits 'much' (rabah) found in some versions/OSMAIN v2, but the core text aligns with OSMAIN v6.
Content matches OSMAIN v7 ('In God is my salvation and honor...').
Content matches OSMAIN v8 ('Trust in him at all times...'). The 'Selah' is included.
Content matches OSMAIN v9 ('Only a breath are the children of men...').

Content matches OSMAIN v10 ('Do not trust in oppression...'). Note: WLC includes 'for it will flee' (ki yanuv) which is implied or phrased slightly differently in the Norwegian translation, but maps to this verse.
Content matches OSMAIN v11 ('Once God has spoken...').
Content matches OSMAIN v12 ('And to you, O Lord, belongs lovingkindness...').

extraContent.description: Superscription/Title: 'For the choir director. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.' This text is present in WLC v1 but OSMAIN incorporates this title into its Verse 1 rather than having a separate verse for it.
